purpose: Map measured cognition-cycle dynamics into the existing LeeWay runtime-state-v1 adapter without modifying LEEWAY-FORMULA-v1.0.

Rao & Ballard (1999), Predictive coding in the visual cortex, doi:10.1038/4580

scientificBasis.concept: variational free energy linking perception, learning and action
emotion/valence as negative rate of change of free energy
scientificBasis.source: Joffily & Coricelli (2013), Emotional Valence and the Free-Energy Principle, doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1003094
Seth (2013), Interoceptive inference, emotion, and the embodied self, doi:10.1016/j.tics.2013.09.007

scientificBasis.concept: belief-based choice minimizing expected free energy
scientificBasis.source: Friston et al. (2016), Active inference and learning, doi:10.1016/j.neubiorev.2016.06.022

scientificBasis.concept: global accessibility as a conscious-access hypothesis
scientificBasis.source: Mashour et al. (2020), Conscious Processing and the Global Neuronal Workspace Hypothesis, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2020.01.026

scientificBasis.concept: prioritized replay by expected value of backup
scientificBasis.source: Mattar & Daw (2018), Prioritized memory access explains planning and hippocampal replay, doi:10.1038/s41593-018-0232-z

cognitionCycle.beliefDefinition: b_t(s) = P(s_t=s | o_1:t, a_1:t-1); belief is a revisable probability distribution, not a permanent proposition.
cognitionCycle.offlineReplay: Stored transitions may be replayed or counterfactually simulated; simulated evidence must remain provenance-marked and cannot be promoted to external fact without Veritas.

dimensions.definition: PE_t = epsilon_t^T Pi_t epsilon_t, epsilon_t = o_t - o_hat_t
dimensions.role: mismatch between predicted and observed evidence
affective/meta-learning signal; candidate operationalization follows Joffily-Coricelli
realized Bayesian information gain from the observation

dimensions.definition: G_t(pi*) for the selected policy; candidate policy posterior q(pi) proportional to exp(-gamma G(pi))
dimensions.role: choice balance between pragmatic preference and epistemic value

dimensions.definition: B_t = acknowledged_required_modules / required_modules for one immutable cognition-state hash
dimensions.role: engineering proxy inspired by global-workspace accessibility; not a proof of phenomenal consciousness

observationWindow.rule: 16 consecutive completed cognition cycles under the same model, sensor, policy, memory, self-model and calibration profile

auxiliaryStateNotCompressedIntoSixDimens: global state hash and per-module acknowledgements

dreamReplay.requirement: Replay is SIMULATED/OFFLINE evidence. It may update internal models only through explicit learning gates and never masquerades as a real external event.
cycle: admit or reject learning with provenance

awarenessBoundary.operationalClaim: This candidate measures and governs awareness-like access, uncertainty, prediction, valuation, policy and learning dynamics.
awarenessBoundary.prohibitedClaim: Formula output or this adapter alone does not prove subjective experience, sentience, phenomenal consciousness, or human equivalence.
researchComparators: integrated information theory as optional comparator, not current control kernel

calibration.rule: No fixed numeric ranges, thresholds or awareness scores are authorized yet. Calibrate on measured non-LLM cognition traces before numeric Formula evaluation.

veritasAcceptance: Each of six dimensions has a deterministic implementation and unit test.
Each dimension has measured finite calibration ranges with provenance.
Same trace and same implementation reproduce identical rows.
Belief and policy distributions normalize correctly.
Dream/replay events are distinguishable from real events by immutable provenance.
Global-access acknowledgements reference the same cognition-state hash.
Formula kernel SHA-256 and runtime-state adapter SHA-256 match canonical pins.
16x6 mapper passes malformed-input, non-finite, missing-module and provenance-negative tests.
Ablation tests show each dimension contributes measurable diagnostic information.
No claim of consciousness is promoted solely from a Formula score.
reason: Candidate semantic mapping exists, but calibration ranges and outcome validation are not yet qualified.
